baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb يَصْلَىٰ is followed by the accusative سَعِيرًا, pairing an act of exposure with the thing undergone.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb contributes bodily encounter with heat while the noun contributes fire in active kindling. Their adjacency profiles not merely a named destination but contact with an escalating process.

activation_trace.role: Exposure to fire and its heat supplies the bodily encounter encoded by the verb.
Kindling and blazing make the object an active intensifying fire rather than a static label.

changed_reading.before: He will simply be punished in a fire.
changed_reading.after: He is brought into bodily contact with a blaze that is actively being kindled and intensified.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb's fire-use inventory includes heating and turning a resistant object until it becomes straight, and its object names the required blaze.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heat acts on resistant material rather than only consuming it. The clause can therefore carry a coercive re-forming image alongside punishment: the subject is exposed to the force that makes what is crooked yield.

activation_trace.role: Heating, turning, and fire-straightening supply a material operation performed through the verb.
The actively kindled blaze supplies the force capable of performing that operation.

changed_reading.before: The blaze only destroys or hurts its subject.
changed_reading.after: The blaze also admits an exploratory image of coercive straightening, with heat forcing resistant form to yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَعِيرًا can activate burning agitation, hunger, thirst, madness, distress, and torment while يَصْلَىٰ keeps that state tied to real heat exposure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fire noun crosses the boundary between environment and condition. The subject does not only occupy a hot place; the blaze is experienced as an inwardly raging, disorganizing state.

activation_trace.role: Encounter with actual fire prevents the inward reading from dissolving into a purely psychological metaphor.
Burning agitation and affliction move the blaze inside the sufferer's body and affect.

changed_reading.before: The fire is wholly outside the person as a surrounding locale.
changed_reading.after: The encountered blaze is simultaneously an inward burning agitation that disorders appetite, feeling, and composure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The baseline straightening image gains a possible telos: lordly repair and completion aim at a state that fits its proper joint or vessel. On this reading the blaze is not softened, but its violence performs compelled alignment.

activation_trace.role: Fire-straightening supplies the material transformation that context can give a governing purpose.
The blazing heat remains the painful operative force rather than becoming an abstract correction.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply a possible governing telos for the heat operation.
Proper fit at a joint or vessel supplies the target image of compelled alignment.

structural_cues: The repeated clauses at 84:2 and 84:5 place listening to the Lord and becoming due or fitting after the transformations of sky and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire-straightening, lordly repair, and proper fit; I supply the arrow that the Lord uses the blaze to force alignment. A live alternative is that these branch images remain independent and the fire is only punitive.

changed_reading.before: The heat merely destroys the condemned person.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the heat is also a coercive operation that drives resistant form toward a due alignment under lordly governance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Strenuous movement accumulates through life and is explicitly directed toward an encounter. For the bearer of the adverse record, the focus clause can render the blaze as the concrete terminal form of what that movement comes to meet.

activation_trace.role: Bodily encounter with fire supplies the terminal contact point.
The blazing object specifies the adverse form taken by that contact.
Laborious striving supplies the long approach whose outcome the focus realizes.
What a person meets of good or evil supplies an outcome-slot into which the blaze can enter.

structural_cues: 84:6 doubles the toil root around motion toward the Lord, while 84:7-12 bifurcates the encounter according to record and response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arduous approach, an eventual meeting, and bodily fire-contact; I identify the focus blaze as one condemned realization of that meeting. The live alternative is that the pronoun at 84:6 refers more broadly to the Lord or one's labor, with 84:12 only a later consequence.

changed_reading.before: The person arrives at an externally assigned fire with no relation to the preceding motion.
changed_reading.after: The fire is the adverse terminus in which a lifetime of directed toil becomes an unavoidable encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: A record fixes an obligation, an account counts it, and recompense names the opposed favorable outcome. This judicial-economic sequence activates the market-price branch of سَعِيرًا, making the bodily blaze an exacted cost rather than an unmeasured eruption.

activation_trace.role: Market valuation supplies the latent image of an assessed price in the focus noun.
Actual fire exposure makes the assessed cost bodily exacted rather than merely monetary.
A written fixing that entails judgment or decree supplies the binding assessment.
Counting and accounting supply the procedure by which the adverse price is determined.
Recompense for work supplies the favorable side of the same outcome-accounting contrast.

structural_cues: The record delivered at the right versus behind the back separates two outcomes; easy accounting and uncut recompense frame the adverse blaze between account terms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a price branch in the focus plus record, account, and recompense; I supply the arrow that the blaze is the assessed cost the adverse record exacts. A live alternative is that the accounting language is judicial only and the price branch contributes no semantic pressure.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is a punishment whose intensity is unrelated to measure or account.
changed_reading.after: The blaze is also read as an assessed and bodily exacted cost within the surah's record-and-recompense economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned person's call is immediately specified as destruction, then followed by fire-contact. The call can function performatively: the next clause realizes as blazing calamity the ruin his own speech summons.

activation_trace.role: Encounter with fire supplies the enacted result that follows the cry.
The blazing fire gives concrete form to the summoned calamity.
Calling down an unwelcome event makes the utterance capable of summoning what follows.
Ruin and destruction specify the content that the blaze then realizes.

structural_cues: The immediate 84:11 to 84:12 sequence moves without an intervening subject change from calling ruin to undergoing blaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a call for descending calamity, destruction, and the following blaze; I supply the performative arrow that the blaze answers or realizes the call. The live alternative is simple temporal juxtaposition: he predicts his fate verbally but does not summon it.

changed_reading.before: The fire is imposed wholly from outside after an unrelated cry.
changed_reading.after: The fire also reads as the grim realization of the ruin the condemned person's own cry has just called forth.

context_deltas.mechanism: One figure returns to family in joy; the other had hidden ease among family and assumed there would be no return. The focus blaze reverses both motions, turning familiar composure into inward agitation and turning denied return into an adverse arrival.

activation_trace.role: Burning agitation supplies the affective inversion of prior ease and joy.
Actual fire-contact supplies the adverse destination in which the reversal lands.
Return and destination establish the favorable homecoming that the adverse sequence inverts.
Hidden joy and ease supply the former affective state consumed by the new agitation.
Return and diminution expose as false the assumption that no reversal or coming-back would occur.

structural_cues: The phrases about being joyful with or among family mirror one another across the two record outcomes, and the second is followed by an explicit denial of return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favorable return, former hidden joy, denied return, and burning agitation; I supply the reversal arrow that 84:12 is an inverted homecoming. A live alternative is that these are moral contrasts without a spatial or affective reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is a detached punishment after an episode of worldly happiness.
changed_reading.after: The blaze is the adverse homecoming: denied return occurs, and concealed familial ease is inverted into embodied agitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The record is placed behind the back, while non-dominant ص ل ي branches locate the rear flank and the racer immediately following a leader. Later riding through successive layers activates the fire noun's rapid-ranging branch. These cues produce a kinetic reading in which the person is driven as a trailing participant along an adverse course.

activation_trace.role: The back and rear-flank image gives the focus verb an otherwise latent spatial hinge.
The second racer following at the leader's rear supplies the trailing relation.
Rapid ranging and hard running give the blaze or its course kinetic force.
Putting something behind the back activates the rearward geometry carried by the focus root.
The bodily back fixes that geometry on the person who will undergo the focus event.
Mounting or undertaking an affair supplies movement through an imposed course.
One foot falling on the trace of another reinforces following through successive stations.

structural_cues: 84:10 makes the adverse record spatially rearward; 84:19 later converts existence into movement through stage after stage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rear placement, back anatomy, a following racer, rapid movement, and successive riding; I supply the arrow that these form one trajectory into the blaze. A live alternative is that the anatomical and racing branches are independent lexical relics with no role in the clause.

changed_reading.before: The person stands in a stationary fire after receiving a record.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the rearward record places him on a fast adverse trajectory, following through successive stations into blazing contact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twilight reddens, night gathers, the moon reaches completeness, and one state succeeds another. That ordered transition activates the sharp-onset branch of سَعِيرًا, so the focus event can be read as an acute phase entered within a larger succession rather than as an undifferentiated timeless condition.

activation_trace.role: A sharp beginning or acute episode supplies the focus event's phase-like profile.
Fire-contact makes entry into that acute phase bodily and concrete.
Sunset redness supplies a visible threshold between conditions.
Completion and even formation supply a phase reaching its full state.
State after state supplies the explicit succession in which the acute blaze can be located.

structural_cues: The oath sequence at 84:16-19 advances from twilight through gathering darkness and lunar completion to an explicit state-after-state formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an acute-onset focus branch and an ordered series of changing states; I supply the arrow that the blaze is one acute phase in that succession. A live alternative is that the oath sequence only guarantees transformation generally and says nothing about the internal temporality of 84:12.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is a static final scene without onset or sequence.
changed_reading.after: The blaze is an acute phase that comes sharply into force within a larger progression from state to state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split ص ل ي inventory holds both prescribed worship and fire exposure. When recitation meets an explicit refusal to lower oneself, those branches align as a dark reversal: voluntary responsive posture is refused, then involuntary exposure replaces it.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies the voluntary response latent in the focus root's non-dominant inventory.
Fire exposure supplies the involuntary counterpart realized in the focus clause.
The active blaze keeps the reversal materially punitive rather than a play on worship vocabulary alone.
Recitation supplies the summons to which embodied response is withheld.
Lowering and humbling supply the refused voluntary posture that the focus fate reverses.

structural_cues: The explicit negation in 84:21 makes embodied non-response, not lack of hearing, the salient failure after recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship and fire branches under the focus root, recitation, and refused lowering; I supply the reversal arrow from refused voluntary submission to forced exposure. A live alternative is that the two focus branches are only polysemous neighbors and should not be causally linked.

changed_reading.before: Fire follows disbelief as a general penalty with no embodied correspondence.
changed_reading.after: Fire-contact becomes a dark embodied reversal: the voluntary lowering invited by recitation was refused, and involuntary exposure takes its place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth establishes a pattern of casting out what is inside and becoming empty. Later denial covers truth while inner meanings are gathered into a container known to God. The focus blaze's inward-agitation branch can therefore be read as concealed content becoming outwardly manifest and bodily unavoidable.

activation_trace.role: Inward burning agitation supplies the latent content capable of being externalized.
Actual blazing gives outward material form to what had been held inwardly.
Encounter makes the manifested content something the person can no longer keep at a distance.
Casting something out supplies the outward movement from interior to exposure.
Emptiness after contents depart completes the packet's container-emptying pattern.
Covering truth supplies the concealment that precedes disclosure.
Gathering meaning in the heart identifies an interior store whose contents are fully known.

structural_cues: 84:4 gives the cosmos an inside-to-outside emptying pattern, while 84:22-24 moves from covering and inward storage to an announced painful outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies casting out, emptying, covering truth, storing meaning, and a focus branch of inward burn; I supply the arrow that concealed denial manifests as the encountered blaze. A live alternative is an external punitive act with no transformation of inner content into outer condition.

changed_reading.before: The fire arrives from outside and bears no material relation to what the person concealed.
changed_reading.after: The blaze is also the externalized form of covered and stored inward disorder, now cast out into an encounter that cannot be evaded.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant س م م mapping supplied for the context word 'sky' and transfers its penetrating hot wind into the mode of fire-contact. It remains packet-backed and anchored in both focus words, but downstream prose should call it a cross-mapped material analogy, not a lexical replacement for sky or blaze.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا still denotes encounter with active fire; the outlier changes that fire's mode from surface contact to penetrating current.

activation_trace.role: Exposure to heat keeps the proposed current tied to the focus verb's concrete event.
Active blazing supplies the heat carried by the proposed current.
A hot penetrating wind from the non-dominant mapping supplies inward passage rather than surface heating alone.
Rupture and opening provide the spatial breach through which the hot current can be imagined to pass.

changed_reading.before: The person contacts the exterior surface of a visible blaze.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, the ruptured cosmos admits a blazing hot current that penetrates rather than merely surrounds him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This bodily reading is surprising because it activates the camel-scab flare-site branch of the focus noun alongside scratch and suppurating-wound context branches. It remains anchored in سَعِيرًا as a site where burning begins and in يَصْلَىٰ as painful heat-contact, but downstream prose should present it only as a somatic analogy for accumulated injury erupting, never as the clause's literal zoological sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The burning flare-point branch belongs directly to سَعِيرًا's root inventory, while the verb preserves actual suffering from heat.

activation_trace.role: A body-site where disease first flares supplies the localized inflammatory image.
Painful heat-contact turns the flare-site into an undergone event rather than a detached anatomical label.
A scratch or bite mark supplies the prior lesion produced by accumulated striving.
A wound filling internally supplies pathological accumulation before eruption.
Pain and suffering confirm the somatic mechanism's affective consequence.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is only a large external environment.
changed_reading.after: As a somatic outlier, the blaze is the point where accumulated scratches and hidden corruption flare into fully felt pain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it combines branch-distant images of a snare and a dug baking chamber, then lets gathering and covering context make them converge spatially. Both images are directly anchored in the two focus roots and form a coherent capture-enclosure mechanism, but downstream prose should qualify it as an imagistic activation rather than claim that سَعِيرًا literally means an oven-pit here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb's non-dominant inventory supplies a set snare, and the noun's inventory supplies an oven-like pit dug into the ground.

activation_trace.role: A set snare supplies capture and loss of exit at the level of the focus verb.
A dug oven-like chamber supplies the enclosing heated space at the level of the focus noun.
Gathering scattered things supplies the inward collection performed by the proposed chamber.
One thing laid over another until it covers supplies closure over what has been gathered.

changed_reading.before: The fire is an open expanse into which the person simply enters.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, the focus becomes capture in a heated chamber that gathers, covers, and prevents escape.

strongest_changes: Record, account, and recompense activate the market-price branch of سَعِيرًا, making the blaze an assessed cost that is bodily exacted.
The refusal to lower oneself after recitation activates worship and fire branches within ص ل ي as a dark voluntary-to-involuntary reversal.
Casting out, emptying, covering, and inward storage recast the blaze as concealed disorder becoming outwardly unavoidable.
Behind-the-back placement and stage-after-stage movement activate the non-dominant back-and-follower branches as a kinetic trajectory into fire.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus is unusually generative because each word can supply both a concrete fire mechanism and a distant cross-domain mechanism. Context repeatedly makes two or more distant branches converge, preserving direct punishment, inward agitation, assessed cost, coerced alignment, reversed worship, moving sequence, and contained capture as coexisting readings rather than forcing a single choice.
remaining_uncertainties: Several high-surprise models depend on treating branch convergence as live analogy even where the branches may be historically or semantically independent.
The sequence strongly licenses reversal and culmination, but causal arrows such as self-invocation or inner content becoming outer blaze remain reader-supplied abductions.
Corrective, racing, somatic, and trap-oven readings need explicit exploratory qualification if rendered in downstream prose.
